source.name: ICH E6(R3) Good Clinical Practice, Annex 2
source.note: Covers decentralised elements, pragmatic elements and the use of real-world data.

mappings.title: Communication with IRB/IEC
mappings.note: Maps to the PI and RA tracks. Annex 2 adds decentralised-specific expectations that CRLN does not yet distinguish from conventional IRB communication.

mappings.title: Informed consent considerations
mappings.note: Strong. CRLN-DCT-D2 was written for exactly this and can now cite a section rather than the Annex generally.

mappings.title: Investigational product management
mappings.note: Strong, via the DCT and PHARM tracks.

mappings.title: Investigator oversight
crln_labels: Knowing the Limit of Your Own Authority
mappings.note: Maps to the PI track and the delegation statements.

mappings.title: Safety assessment and reporting
mappings.note: Strong, via DCT-D4 and the safety statements across tracks.

mappings.title: Engagement and communication
mappings.note: CRLN covers sponsor-site communication but not participant and community engagement in trial design, which is what Annex 2 emphasises.

mappings.title: Protocol and trial design
mappings.note: CRLN is execution-side and begins after a protocol exists. Trial design is out of scope by construction, not by oversight.

mappings.title: Communication with IRB/IEC
mappings.note: Maps to the RA and CTA tracks.

mappings.title: Access to and use of RWD
mappings.note: NO CRLN COUNTERPART. Real-world data does not appear anywhere in CRLN-TRG-001.

mappings.title: Access to RWD
mappings.note: NO CRLN COUNTERPART. Nothing in the framework addresses obtaining or governing access to real-world data sources.

mappings.title: Consent and permission considerations for RWD
mappings.note: NO CRLN COUNTERPART. CRLN's consent statements are all trial-participant consent. Consent and permission for secondary use of real-world data is a different problem and is absent.

mappings.title: Data considerations
mappings.note: CRLN covers trial data integrity well; the Annex 2 additions concern data not generated by the trial.

mappings.title: RWD Considerations
mappings.note: NO CRLN COUNTERPART. Provenance, fitness for purpose and quality of real-world data are unaddressed.

mappings.title: Remote data collection considerations
crln_labels: Connected Device, Wearable & ePRO Data Integrity
mappings.note: Strong. DCT-D3 and DCT-D6 were written for this and can now cite the section.

mappings.title: Investigational product management
mappings.note: Strong, across DCT, PHARM and CRA.

mappings.title: Privacy and confidentiality considerations
mappings.note: Only one CRLN statement, on the ASSIST track, addresses confidentiality. Annex 2 treats privacy as a sponsor-level design obligation, which CRLN does not cover.

mappings.title: Sponsor oversight
mappings.note: Strong, across DCT, PM and CRA.
